stem: Which ending result or final point follows “History is full of strange clothes, tools, and laws.”?
options: Good decisions often need both wide views and close contact.
When people understand the reason, they often behave better.
But emotions often cross centuries more easily than facts do.
Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.
